narrative:
Williams County has 24,285 registered voters, with 16.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 35.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 44.3%, a clear Democratic lean of 8.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.4% of registrants.
